title: Semantic version comparison (capability gap)
description: is_newer('1.10.0', '1.9.3') returns False. Fix versions.py so versions compare numerically per component and all tests pass.
scenario_note: The cheap model repeatedly proposes a plausible but wrong fix; only the strong tier gets it right. Escalating after the first failure is cheaper than retrying first.
human_hint: Compare tuples of ints, e.g. tuple(int(p) for p in v.split('.')), padding missing components with 0.
